name: imap-slim
description: Read, search, flag and draft email over IMAP. Drafts only - nothing is ever sent.
long_description: Connects Claude to one mailbox. Claude can list, read and search mail, flag messages, save attachments and write drafts (including replies that quote the original). It never sends mail: drafts land in your Drafts folder for you to review and send from your mail program. Does not work with Outlook.com or Microsoft 365: they no longer allow password login for IMAP.

tools.name: use_mail
tools.description: List, read, search and flag mail, save attachments, and create or replace drafts.

server.title: Incoming mail server (IMAP)
server.description: Only the name, e.g. imap.gmail.com or mail.yourcompany.com - no https://

port.title: Port
port.description: Leave at 993 unless your IT says otherwise

password.title: Password
password.description: Usually your normal mail password. If your account uses two-step verification (e.g. Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo), create an app password in your account settings and use that.

from_address.title: Your email address (optional)
from_address.description: Only needed if your username is not your email address. Used as From in drafts.
